settings_registry_editor_buffer_font_des: Font for the editor and diffs.
settings_registry_editor_buffer_line_hei: Space between lines of code, as a multiple of the font size.
settings_registry_editor_buffer_size_des: Text size in the editor and diffs, in pixels.
settings_registry_editor_description: The code editor and diffs: font, indentation and display, and the language servers behind completion.
settings_registry_editor_editor_auto_rel: Update an open file when another program changes it, as long as you have no unsaved edits in it.
settings_registry_editor_editor_bracket_: Give each level of nested brackets its own color.
settings_registry_editor_editor_final_ne: End every file with exactly one newline when you save.
Add a final newline on save
settings_registry_editor_editor_highligh: Tint the line the cursor is on.
settings_registry_editor_editor_indent_g: Draw a faint vertical line at each level of indentation.
settings_registry_editor_editor_insert_s: Pressing Tab inserts spaces. Turn off to insert tab characters.
settings_registry_editor_editor_large_fi: Files bigger than this open in a light mode without language features, so the editor stays fast. 0.1 to 100 MB.
settings_registry_editor_editor_line_num: Show line numbers in the gutter.
settings_registry_editor_editor_minimap_: Show a small overview of the file on the right.
settings_registry_editor_editor_rulers_d: Columns where a vertical line is drawn, such as 80 or 100. Separate several with commas.
settings_registry_editor_editor_scroll_p: Let the last line scroll up to the top of the editor.
settings_registry_editor_editor_smooth_s: Animate scrolling when you jump to a line or use the keyboard.
settings_registry_editor_editor_sticky_s: Keep the enclosing function or class pinned at the top while you scroll its body.
settings_registry_editor_editor_tab_size: Columns a tab or one level of indentation spans.
settings_registry_editor_editor_trim_whi: Remove spaces and tabs at the end of lines when you save.
settings_registry_editor_editor_whitespa: Draw dots for spaces and arrows for tabs.
settings_registry_editor_editor_word_wra: Wrap long lines at the edge of the editor.
settings_registry_editor_lsp_custom_desc: Run your own server for a language: its command, arguments, initialization options and settings.
settings_registry_editor_lsp_enable_desc: Completion, diagnostics, hover and go to definition from the language's server (downloaded on first use).
settings_registry_editor_lsp_format_on_s: Format the file with its language server every time it is saved.
settings_registry_editor_lsp_inlay_hints: Show inferred types and parameter names inline, dimmed.
settings_registry_editor_lsp_manage_desc: Install, update or replace the server of each language.
settings_registry_editor_lsp_project_des: Override servers for one project with a file inside it; it wins over your own settings.
settings_registry_editor_lsp_servers_des: See which language servers are installed, install or update them, and open their logs.
settings_registry_editor_tab_editor_desc: Font, indentation and display of the code editor and diffs.
settings_registry_editor_tab_languages_d: Install, update and replace the language server of each language.
